patch_description:
This construction reframes the 14-point diameter packing as a 7-line packing problem: each optimized unit direction is returned together with its antipode. Antipodal pairs automatically set the diameter to 2, while the minimum distance is controlled solely by the largest absolute inner product between distinct lines.

The algorithm first performs deterministic projected repulsion on the sphere using increasingly sharp power energies to discover balanced line-contact graphs. It then applies SLSQP to the direct minimax formulation, minimizing the maximum squared line correlation subject to unit-vector constraints. This directly targets the evaluator ratio while avoiding arbitrary box constraints or a fragile fixed polyhedral construction.
